status: S4 construction/count and isolated validation complete; independent design check required before native layout work
objective: Preserve the exact approved Shieldstral integer function while replacing padded model/FFN axes with public power-of-two pieces.

geometry.unchanged: T128/T256, Q4096, KV1024, head dimension128, 32query/8KVheads, FP12, H24 and per-layer G
geometry.commitments: A and H remain single ordered row matrices containing all typed pieces. Each endpoint/internal boundary uses two separate piece commitments in the conservative construction; their ordered root pair is bound in the new profile policy.

construction_A_explicit.description: Prove each matrix subproduct separately and hide its partial result in committed A planes. Never send unmasked partial dot products.
construction_A_explicit.partial_planes: One field-valued partial per inner-split output piece: Q1, K1, V1, gate1 and up1 per Fpiece, down1 per Dpiece, plus two T-valued partial square sums. The complementary partial is total minus committed partial, at a shared output point.
construction_A_explicit.binding: Host both subproduct equations with independent random batch coefficients at the same output point. One partial is committed before challenges; the other is the original quantized host expression minus that partial.
construction_A_explicit.range_argument: Partial values need no standalone integer limb class if both field matmul equations and the existing total-host integer bounds are proved. Eliminating the partial recovers the original no-wrap equation. This elimination and the shared-point mask coupling require review.
construction_A_explicit.overhead: 19 additional CFS slots,85 additional A sites,25 additional H sites; partial data T*27648 +2*N base-field words. See COUNT.json for the per-family derivation.

construction_B_batched_zero_lift.description: Use one sumcheck for the sum of the two inner-piece products. It has one combined initial claim and does not publish separate partial results.
construction_B_batched_zero_lift.identity: For ratio2^k, lift the smaller piece by sigma=product(1-b_j) over the k missing leading FEATURE bits, after token coordinates. D1->D0 has k1;F1->F0 has k3. Lift BOTH factors; on the Boolean cube sigma^2=sigma, so the summed product equals the true smaller dot product.
construction_B_batched_zero_lift.terminal_opening: At a challenge point remove exactly those k feature coordinates, multiply the complete masked functional by product(1-r_bj), and never divide. Keep token and CFS extension coordinates in their original order. Zero sigma is a zero functional, not a retry.
construction_B_batched_zero_lift.degree_obligation: The lifted polynomial is multilinear in the larger cube. Certify native declared degree and the extension-zero property on the actual typed source-to-cube map. Treating an arbitrary repeated table as a lift is invalid.
construction_B_batched_zero_lift.mask_obligation: Scale the complete masked functional, not only its data value. Allocate an independent reserved pair for every new physical claim and re-prove CFS coupling; existing rank/privacy approval does not transfer automatically.
construction_B_batched_zero_lift.other_slots: One combined row-square sum per norm; duplicate D/F zero checks and both IO equality slots. Score, PV, row-exp sum, DD and table checks remain one family each.
construction_B_batched_zero_lift.overhead: 8 additional CFS slots,74 additional A sites,25 additional H sites; no private partial planes. These are a proposed schedule, not a measured native layout.
construction_B_batched_zero_lift.zero_functional_adapter: sigma=0 implies the entire functional and terminal are zero. Shared trusted claim assembly MUST check terminal==0 before removing that functional. Keep the fixed terminal in the CFS transcript. Do not call native open_zk on an all-zero group and do not weaken its mask assertion. No division or retry.

relations_touched: Both norm square sums must add D0 and D1 before the integer square root. Both pieces share the same denominator, Cn, ceps and norm_tn. Never normalize pieces independently.
All D-domain residual, word/limb, norm remainder and AO/down host equations run on each Dpiece. F-domain gate, up, scaled ACT, product H24 and remainders run on each Fpiece.
Q/K/V sum over both Dinputs; O has two Doutputs; gate/up have two Foutputs and two Dinputs; down has two Doutputs and two Finputs. Do not round subproducts separately: round once after the full sum.

Per-output c2 multipliers and gate folds retain global channel indices. F1 index j means global channel8192+j; D1 index i means global channel2048+i. Canonical group IDs and table scaling remain exactly R13.
All existing true words must map bijectively to piece/offset. Weight tensor orientation, source hashes and the public model identity use true global axes, not an ambiguous concatenated local index.

A/H row placement, claim sites, mask pairs, source-coordinate maps, functional grouping, slot IDs and wire ceilings change. Introduce a new versioned layout profile; keep all R13/legacy branches and bytes fixed.

IO policies and hidden internal boundaries bind ordered piece roots and exact extents. Prove both pieces against the same logical endpoint; reject piece swaps, duplication, dropped tails and cross-run root substitution.
Byte and ACT histograms sum all pieces into the existing single global families. True Fqueries shrink to T*9216; do not double-count tables or retain the old padded ACTqueries.

D/F padding constraints become unnecessary on the true piece cubes. T/L padding and table-family support tails remain required. Every H-bearing piece is at least N for T128/T256, preserving the one column-weight key for the LogUp zero-sum claim; prove this using the final layout.

DD score geometry, Sum key, cap32 and all-slot FP12 quotient constraints remain unchanged. Only the aggregate lookup numerator/count changes. Re-derive the ACT3/DD rational-identity term from the new position count.

PCS column-weight keys change when D/F coordinates are removed. Keep distinct physical claims in separate ZClaims unless their projected tails/ranges coincide; do not combine unequal column weights. The global all-ones H sum remains a separate case.

counting.exact_anchor: A roles and lookup lists are executed directly from the frozen accuracy_layout.rs/accuracy_precision.rs with unchanged legacy scalar constants. Python reproduces all four native Shieldstral FE9 A/H data rows, total rows and byte counts before applying any model.
counting.new_schedule: Both alternatives include dedicated two-row mask pairs for the additional claim sites. M remains two rows per CFS slot plus four only if every new message still fits the existing 256-word mask-message budget. Verify this with the final degree/slot census.
counting.endpoints: Two independent piece commitments each retain five mask rows: total34 rows per logical endpoint versus37 at the current T/N ratio. A joint commitment might save masks but requires another joint-functional rank analysis and is not charged here.
counting.exclusions: A/H percentage comparisons follow the existing native convention; endpoint and M row counts are reported separately. Receipt size, hash work and exact prover scratch allocations are not yet counted.

memory_conclusion: Old R12 fit estimates are not R13 fit evidence. Calibrating on measured R13 actual-L00/T128 peaks gives batched T256 models12.17-13.76GiB nonDD and11.04-12.31GiB DD as fixed scratch varies0-2GiB. The guard budget is11.89GiB, and declaration margin is additional. No T256 fit claim is justified yet.
soundness_and_privacy_reread: D24: exact source-coordinate maps, public matrix subproduct algebra, single rounding, no-wrap elimination, output and remainder linkage, adaptive partial-result claims, native degree checks and extension-zero property.
D12/D12a: ordered endpoint/boundary root pairs, ownership, no missing piece, fresh independent mask allocation and one logical cross-layer equality.

CFS/PCS: every physical claim has its own reserved mask pair; weighted/lifted opening coefficients and shared points are authenticated; no mask reuse across pieces; one opening per A/H/M commitment remains justified.

D30 and lookup: every DD slot remains constrained and inverted; ACT3 group coordinate remains public and bound; one global zero-sum claim; recompute N, table supports and the formal nonzero numerator premise.

Hash domains/wire: new profile and slot identities, whole-registry key distinctness, constructor/absorb separation, source-pin and SHA-call coverage, canonical layout digest and fail-closed old/new schema handling.

Privacy: new rank lemma and NL-1/joint-view captures; public coefficient zero cases; two-piece endpoint openings; no exposure of partial matmul values; refusal-channel analysis. No inherited privacy approval is assumed.
next_validation: Coordinator routes the independent soundness/privacy design check requested in DESIGN_REVIEW_REQUEST.json; native layout implementation remains held under the explicit 06:35 coordination instruction.

After resolving the design check, replace proposed slot/claim counts with a native census; validate all M coefficient budgets, physical terminals, hash/domain and wire registrations before relying on a new profile.
After an explicit new profile, compare all19 native trace sites/output with R13, then full T128 native prove/verify/fresh/tamper and endpoint-piece attacks. Microproofs do not establish those gates.
Measure split live buffers/RSS; plan T256 proofs for the 5090 desktop under appropriate admission, not by reducing laptop declarations.
